Design data only: CAD measurements (research_notes/trade_study/measurements.json), stock firmware configs and the community motor database. Triples are [low, nominal, high]. Do not edit after the freeze; recalibration proposals live in calibration.py (PROPOSED), not here.

_sources.cad: research_notes/trade_study/measurements.json (STEP assemblies of VoronDesign/Voron-0 a0d5d1bc, VoronDesign/Voron-Trident 7fcb3257, Creality3DPrinting/Ender-3 88c7758c; masses are solid volume x assumed density)
_sources.motor_db: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/andrewmcgr/klipper_tmc_autotune/main/motor_database.cfg (community transcription of datasheets: R, L, holding torque, rated current, step angle)

voron0.label: Voron 0.2r1 (120 mm CoreXY)
voron0.motor_note: R, L, torque, current: motor_db. Rotor inertia is a class value for a 52 mm NEMA 14 (assumed; it does not enter the resonance prediction).
voron0.current_note: The stock config leaves run_current blank and says: 60-70 % of 0.707 x rated. 0.65 x 0.707 x 1.5 A = 0.69 A. Range covers users at 0.5 A and the 1.68 A kit motor at 70 %.
voron0.mass_note: CAD estimate -10 % / +25 %: the CAD masses leave out belts, wiring, the umbilical and most fasteners, so the range is skewed up.

trident250.label: Voron Trident 250 (CoreXY)
trident250.motor_note: The stock config is written for 1.8 deg motors (full_steps_per_rotation 200). Many kits ship the 0.9 deg LDO-42STH48-2004MAH (0.44 N m, 1.4 ohm, 2.0 mH); that variant is reported as an alternative. Rotor inertia: class value for a 48 mm NEMA 17, as in reference.py.
trident250.current_note: Stock config run_current 0.8; tuned machines run higher.

y.moves: X beam, rail, joints and toolhead

trident250.mass_note: CAD estimate -10 % / +25 %, as for the Voron 0.

ender3.label: Creality Ender 3 (bed slinger, V-wheels)
ender3.motor_note: R, L, torque, current: motor_db (the 0.4 N m at 1.0 A entry is itself a community figure). Rotor inertia: class value for a 34 mm NEMA 17 (assumed).
ender3.current_note: Not in any config (the drivers are set by a trim pot). 0.58 A RMS is the commonly quoted factory setting, recalled, low confidence.
ender3.stock_note: 300 / 3000 are the limits in the Klipper example config, not Creality's Marlin defaults (500 mm/s^2).
ender3.mass_note: X: CAD -10 % / +25 %. Y: the CAD bed is a bare 3 mm aluminium plate on its carriage; real machines add a build surface (sticker 0.05 kg to glass 0.45 kg), so the range runs far up. Nothing printed on the bed.
